نرتش (form VIII)
# نَرْتَشِ (nartaši) /nar.ta.ʃi/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِرْتَشَى (irtašā)
# نُرْتَشَ (nurtaša) /nur.ta.ʃa/: first-person plural non-past passive jussive of اِرْتَشَى (irtašā)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
